data.narrative:
Arbe Robotics is a public-stage company in the Drones & Autonomous sector that has raised $118M to date. The valuation universe for this company is constrained: while seven private peers operate in the same sector—including Joby Aviation, Archer Aviation, Zipline, Nuro, and Elroy Air—no public comparables exist in this space. This sparse comp environment limits the applicability of standard triangulation methods.

The Peer-Median approach is not applicable here. Although five same-sector peers exist in Drones & Autonomous, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier companies yields fewer than three datapoints in any single bucket. A broad all-sector median would introduce excessive noise and is therefore inappropriate for deriving a credible valuation range.

Given the methodological constraints, this analysis cannot triangulate a supported valuation range using the available data. The core uncertainty is the thinness of comparable companies at Arbe's stage and market position. Completion of a rigorous valuation would require either (1) deeper financial metrics from the private peer set to enable multiple-based scaling, (2) DCF modeling anchored to Arbe-specific revenue and margin assumptions, or (3) evidence of recent funding rounds or transactions in the peer set to establish current market pricing. Without these inputs, quantitative synthesis is premature.
